{{Quote|Chalactans believe that all the natural laws of the universe also exist within us, and the goal of the adept is to strive to understand them and be illuminated.|[[Prithi]]|<ref name="Star Wars (2013) 5">[[Star Wars (2013) 5|''Star Wars'' (2013) 5]]</ref>}}
The '''Chalactan Adepts''' or '''Adepts of [[Chalacta/Legends|Chalacta]]''' were a philosophical-mystic order of [[Chalactan/Legends|Chalactans]] that studied at the [[Temple of Illumination]]. The organization was run by the [[Convocation of Adepts]]. Their teachings allowed for invulnerability to [[Mind trick/Legends|mental manipulation]] and [[Torture/Legends|torture]].

==Overview==
The Adepts believed that the natural laws that governed the universe also governed the lives of those who inhabited it. The goal of every Adept was to seek the [[Chalactan Enlightenment]]. Those who reached it wore the [[Greater Mark of Illumination]]; those who were seeking it wore the [[Lesser Mark of Illumination|Lesser Mark]]. The two marks together symbolized the Adepts. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Depa Billaba/Legends|Depa Billaba]] had attained the rank of Adept in the final decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
